title: The Reading Lamp in the Middle
youtube_title: The Reading Lamp in the Middle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Sora sees that reading lamp slid to the middle of the table will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Sora makes a smaller, even share so Kavi is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
